role: Observable mirror of Polar strap state (connection, streaming, battery, on-device recording, device type, fetch progress) so BLE-state views re-render independently of the collector. Written by RRCollector+Bindings.swift (e.g. lines 51, 66, 72, 202), read via @Environment.
toplevel: Stored-property defaults only (false/nil/.idle/.disconnected). All properties are publicly settable (no private(set)), so any holder of the environment object can write them.

flags.text: Doc says the only writer is RRCollector+Bindings.setupBindings(), but RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift:95 writes deviceStatus.isStreaming = false directly, racing the binding that sets it from PolarManager (RRCollector+Bindings.swift:95).
